record.classification: source tables Restricted; the synthetic pair handled as Restricted under the agreement (board's assessment)
conditions: 1. the request is resubmitted by the university on the Data-Sharing Request Form
2. written approval of the university's academic authority and its ethics committee is attached
3. a data-sharing agreement names the users, the purpose (no commercial use without a new request) and the 24-month term
4. only the synthetic pair of the eleven model features leaves the consortium; no real record is copied
5. no onward sharing; the file is deleted at the end of the term and deletion is confirmed in writing
6. any publication reports results from the consortium's run on real data, not from the synthetic file
record.decision: conditional approval: nothing is released until conditions 1 to 3 are met
record.method: a synthetic pair (conditional trees, leaf 25) of the eleven model features for model development; final fitting and validation run by the consortium on the real data from code the group submits
record.residual_risk: membership AUC 0.55 (patients) and 0.511 (encounters), under the board's 0.60; the synthetic file is still derived from personal data and is shared under agreement, not published
record.review_date: at resubmission, and before any extension of the term
record.utility_evidence: TSTR AUC 0.705 against 0.706 on real data; heart-failure risk ratio 1.91 inside the real interval 1.84-2.33
record.why_not_extract: record-level stays: 97% of patients with two stays are unique on sex, year of birth and those two stays
